conditions.description: Participation restricted to legal entities established in EU Member States, Iceland, Norway, and associated countries: Canada, Israel, Republic of Korea, New Zealand, Switzerland, and the United Kingdom.
Entities controlled by non-eligible countries may be excluded from participation unless appropriate guarantees are provided.
Activities are expected to start at TRL 2 and achieve TRL 5 by the end of the project.
Maximum EU contribution per project is 19,000,000 EUR. Total indicative topic budget is 38,000,000 EUR for an indicative number of 2 funded projects.
Standard Horizon Europe RIA minimum consortium composition applies: at least 3 legal entities from 3 different eligible countries, including at least 2 EU Member States or associated countries.
conditions.assumption_note: No specific consortium composition requirement or derogation is stated in the topic text or call extract for HORIZON-CL4-2026-05-DIGITAL-EMERGING-02 (call_entry.eligibility_conditions field is an empty string in the slice). The standard Horizon Europe RIA minimum consortium requirement is assumed to apply by default. Must be verified against General Annex B of the applicable work programme before use in compliance checking.
